newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish bourse seen extending recent gains.
newsitem.headline: Polish bourse seen extending recent gains.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to extend last week's 4.1-percent rise and the 25-percent surge since mid-December, as ever more domestic investors join the foreign players thought to have spurred the latest growth.
But analysts said the market's rises to successive 33-month highs could end in a profit-taking correction later this week.
They said the recent surge by the more speculative Universal signalled a heightened presence of domestic buyers. Universal did not trade after price-fixing on Friday due to excess demand.
